description: This file declares debug functions related to nl80211 information for wireless interfaces, wiphy, stations, and related data structures. It includes license and copyright information, include guards, and function prototypes for dumping various nl80211 debug info into variant maps.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_dumpIfaceInfo
methods.description: Dumps all wiphy info into a variant map for debugging purposes.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_dumpWiphyInfo
methods.description: Dumps all wiphy info into a variant map for debugging purposes.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_dumpStationInfo
methods.description: Dumps all station info into a variant map for debugging purposes.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_dumpAllStationInfo
methods.description: Dumps all stations info into a map tree for debugging purposes.
